description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mukkama, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511200
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on property rights and land title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
